questions.question: You are at a restaurant with a friend. Your friend has accidentally spilled coffee on your jacket. Which response is the most appropriate?
options: That's terrible. I'll just wash it myself later.
Oh no! That's a shame. Let me get you a napkin and call the waiter.
You always do this. It happens all the time.
Don't worry about it. It's not that big a deal.
questions.answer: Oh no! That's a shame. Let me get you a napkin and call the waiter.

questions.question: A colleague asks for your opinion on a new project idea. You think it is risky but could be successful. How should you respond?
options: I think it's a terrible idea. We should never do that.
That sounds like a great plan. I'm fully on board.
I'm not sure it's the best idea, but it might work if we manage the risks carefully.
I don't have any opinion on this matter.
questions.answer: I'm not sure it's the best idea, but it might work if we manage the risks carefully.

questions.question: You are at a party and someone offers you a drink. You are not thirsty and prefer not to drink alcohol. What is the most polite way to decline?
options: I don't want any. I hate alcohol.
No thanks, I'm driving home later.
That's fine, thanks anyway.
I'm not feeling well today.
questions.answer: No thanks, I'm driving home later.

questions.question: Your friend is struggling with a difficult task and seems upset. You want to offer support. Which option is the most empathetic and helpful response?
options: Just do it quickly. You can't fail.
Why are you complaining? It's not that hard.
I'm sorry you're going through this. Let me know if you need help or a distraction.
I told you not to take on so much work.
questions.answer: I'm sorry you're going through this. Let me know if you need help or a distraction.

questions.question: You are writing an email to a professor to request an extension on an assignment due tomorrow. Which opening phrase is the most appropriate?
options: Hey, I need more time on this.
Hi Professor Smith, I'm writing to ask for a deadline extension because...
Dear Sir/Madam, I want to change my grade.
Hello, can you give me more time?
questions.answer: Hi Professor Smith, I'm writing to ask for a deadline extension because...
